name: Cutch State
description: A red field charged with white emblems: a fortress, an elephant, a crescent and sun, above a scroll reading 'COURAGE AND CONFIDENCE'.
history: Flag of Cutch (Kutch), the Jadeja Rajput state on the Rann of Kutch, which acceded to India in 1948.

features.role: fortress, elephant, crescent and sun with motto scroll
